t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice tells me that there are pairs where a particular color gives more mushroom than the other, although it does not always stay true, and i can try to switch it up a little if the color i keep picking does not give me good numbers

vb_textbox.text: So, I'm of the opinion that it could all just be a mind game, or the bigger point would be selected at random, and you might think it's a particular combination or color that gives bigger values,Although what seems to work for me was pointed cap gives higher points wehn paired with round hats, Always pick purple, and yellow most of the time, it's really not so much of a big deal, take the first 10 games to study the patterns and their result, stick to it and ride your own wave
